title: Intelligent Decision
subtitle: The Intelligence Shift
theme: Marketing isn't a bet anymore: see it, measure it, fix it
keyPoints: Omnichannel replaces multichannel: online and offline should be one experience. Start fixing with a small, workable MVP.
Wrap reports aren't enough: track constantly from consumers' daily lives. Every wave is a chance for the next.
Outdoor ads must clear three tests: measurement, automated trading, dynamic delivery. Add mobile ads, and recall hits 2.2x.
quote: We used to judge marketing by the “rearview mirror.” AI lets us look ahead to the future more accurately.

title: Intelligent Decision 2019
subtitle: The Transformation Rush
theme: Data shows the surface, not always the truth
keyPoints: Caveman effect: analyzing only the data that survives misleads you. Add sample surveys, channel interviews, and small data.
A brand must say clearly what it is before talking reach. Transformation runs on people and internal talk, not just tools.
Before AI, nail five small things: data quality, a good app, data talent, the right metrics, and not treating forecasts as magic.
quote: The word “Digital” is out of style. It's all “Data” now!

title: Intelligent Decision 2020
subtitle: The Post-Pandemic Era
theme: Back to your own customers: first-party data and LTV
keyPoints: Don't just cut back: weigh pandemic impact and demand elasticity, then sort markets: booming, emerging, potential, stagnating.
As third-party cookies exit and walled gardens fragment data, bridge pain points with first-party data and data fusion.
Don't split brand and performance: Adidas found 65% of sales came from brand activity and moved to 60% brand, 40% performance.
quote: Observing a “phenomenon” doesn't mean grasping the “truth,” let alone understanding the “cause.”

title: Intelligent Decision 2021
subtitle: Crossing
keyPoints: Home becomes a business hub: brands need full digital operations and the ability to “deliver to the door.”
After third-party cookies, build your own first-party data and identity. Create value first; don't sink in a data swamp.
Authenticity and trust are the new edge: Sinyi Realty's “Trust and Happiness” ad sold nothing; positive post-test rose 70%.

title: Intelligent Decision 2022
subtitle: Compound Leap
theme: From me to us: let customers pitch in
keyPoints: Three kinds of fragmentation: media, the customer journey, and a market of five generations. The fix: marketing flexibility.
Sustainability is a must: 85% of people in Taiwan think eco products cost more; 71% feel they lack information.
Modern Creativity seeks work that creates culture, changes society, and defines the future.
quote: As for the future, your task is not to foresee it, but to enable it.

title: Intelligent Decision: Empowered Evolution
subtitle: Co-Create the Unseen
theme: AI is a good teammate. People still make the call
keyPoints: First-party data is the foundation for monetizing AI: garbage in, garbage out.
Anyone can make images with prompts, but AI draws “six fingers” and pretends to know what it doesn't.
As content gets cheaper, fakes and infringement risks rise. Contracts must spell out AI use and disclosure.
quote: AI is learning, and we're learning AI. This is an age of conversation.

title: Innovating to Impact
subtitle: INNOVATING TO IMPACT
theme: Everyone uses AI. Core brand values make the difference
keyPoints: A brand is where all marketing investment adds up. The more fragmented things get, the more you return to core values.
Resonate with society: UNIQLO's East District partnership grew foot traffic to 2.2x the year before.
Customer experience is now standard. Build brand values into it, while respecting privacy and inclusivity.
quote: How good AI is depends mostly on how good you are.

title: Intelligent Decision 2025
subtitle: Building the Marketing Intelligence Chain for the Algorithm Era
theme: Algorithms: efficiency. Brands: what can't be generated
keyPoints: Data isn't truth: Brand Lift may only light up people who already supported you.
Traditional media isn't dead: targeting 30+, TV CPM is about 48; YouTube usually runs 80–250.
AI goes from tool to agent. Customers and brands each have agents, and the rules of search and shopping get rewritten.
quote: When algorithms find audiences, make content, and place ads, brands must ask: what value “can't be generated”?

title: Intelligent Decision 2026
subtitle: The Agentic Era: Reshaping the Real Distance Between Brands and People
theme: AI helps brands understand people. That's real closeness
keyPoints: Agent permissions have four levels: observe/understand, recommend, decide, act. More autonomy isn't always better.
People Model has a 0.89 correlation with real-person surveys, but correlation isn't accuracy.
Generation is a commodity; delivery is the moat. Human-in-the-loop projects beat full automation on ROI by 104%.
quote: An agent's limits are designed in. They are not flaws.
